description:
Stop the reply Luca is writing for one inbound turn. A queued draft that is still pending is taken back; an approved or sent one is not. The turn stays on the drafting list for 24 hours so it can be retried or dismissed.

Luca operation: POST /api/review-queue/drafting/{turnId}/cancel
Required scopes: review_queue:write
Required OAuth scope: luca:queue_ops; data sensitivity: redacted
Requires Idempotency-Key. Provide idempotencyKey for safe retries, or the server will generate one.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for safe retries. If omitted, the MCP server generates a unique key for this call.

name: luca_review_queue_drafting_cancel
title: Cancel a draft in progress
